title: Basketball Motor Imagery EEG Dataset
description: EEG recordings from 35 healthy participants performing three basketball-related motor observation and motor imagery tasks: single-handed dribbling, two-handed ball passing, and two-person passing. The dataset includes raw EEG, preprocessed data, and phase locking value (PLV) functional connectivity results. It supports research on motor imagery, action observation, and inter-brain connectivity in sports-related contexts.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with an ANT Neuro system (64 channels, 1000 Hz sampling rate) while participants performed dribble (5 conditions), ballpass (4 conditions), and two-person passing tasks (4 combined conditions and 4 PLV conditions). Raw data, preprocessed data, and PLV functional connectivity results are provided.
